chunks: For when the trumpet is blown

key_terms.النَّاقُور: the trumpet (specifically the one used for the first blow of Resurrection)

ai.seo_question: What happens when the trumpet is blown in Islamic eschatology?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse marks the definitive end of the 'Breath of Death' (Nafkhat al-Fana) and the beginning of the 'Breath of Resurrection' (Nafkhat al-Ba'th), where the Angel Israfil blows the trumpet to awaken all souls. This event is distinct from the first blow that causes universal death, emphasizing the transition from the temporal world to the eternal realm of accountability before Allah.
